vibe: Technical, precise, fast, and highly reliable. Clean & minimal SaaS style.

mono.usage: Use for overlines, labels, code snippets, and metric numbers. tracking-[0.2em] for uppercase labels.

hierarchy.label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-orange-500 font-semibold

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: The 'Control Room' grid. Dense and precise. Use border-collapse patterns or 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200) for feature cards to create a technical skeleton look.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text and features. Center-align hero and primary CTA sections for high impact.

buttons.primary: bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 text-slate-900 font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white border border-slate-200 p-8 rounded-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
cards.dark_code: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-6 rounded-lg text-slate-300 font-mono text-sm shadow-xl

navigation.style: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-slate-200/50 sticky top-0 z-50

hero_abstract.description: 3D isometric floating dashboard for hero section visual

code_texture.description: Abstract macro shot of code lines for background texture or How It Works section

visual_regression.description: Mobile UI wireframe with bug highlighted in orange. Use in Features section.

icons.instruction: Use lucide-react for standard UI icons. Use react-icons/si (Simple Icons) for integration brand logos like GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Slack, and Jira.

sections.name: Hero
sections.instructions: Split layout or centered layout with a massive H1 (e.g., 'Ship faster with zero bugs.'). Include a monospace overline label. Primary CTA ('Start Free Testing') and a secondary text CTA ('View Documentation'). Below text, use the 'hero_abstract' image in a subtle floating animation (framer-motion). Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.

sections.name: Integrations Logo Strip
sections.instructions: A smooth marquee or CSS grid of brand logos using react-icons/si (SiGithub, SiGitlab, SiJenkins, SiSlack, SiJira). Muted slate-400 color, turning to brand color on hover.

sections.name: Features (Bento Grid / Control Room)
sections.instructions: Use a dense grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6). Cards with 1px border. Showcase E2E testing, visual regression (use 'visual_regression' image), AI-powered test generation, and Cross-browser capabilities. Some cards can feature a mock 'dark_code' block snippet.

sections.name: How It Works
sections.instructions: 3-4 step process. Use vertical timeline or horizontal numbered cards. Include code snippets in a dark slate-900 container for the 'Write Test' step.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.instructions: 3 tiers (Free, Pro, Enterprise). Highlight 'Pro' with an orange top border and slight scale. Use 'Grid Borders' strategy for a clean, technical price table.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.instructions: Use grid of cards. Avatar images from media.testimonials URLs. Include fake titles like 'QA Lead, TechCorp'.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.instructions: Accordion style layout using Shadcn UI components customized with our light theme borders.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.instructions: Dark section (bg-slate-900) to create a stark contrast at the bottom of the page. Large white text, orange primary button. Use 'code_texture' as a very faint background overlay (opacity-10).

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All buttons, links, inputs, and interactive components MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='pricing-pro-tier').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. The orange (#F97316) button should have white text for contrast.
